时间在忙碌中总是过得很快，一转眼又到周末了。这一周唯一发生的大事儿，就是贾东旭被人打断了腿，这一次应该就是那帮小混混的报复了。

王野也没有去看热闹，这种事儿还是躲远点儿的好，万一惹火烧身就不好了。贾家虽然知道这是上次事情的后续，但是也拿王野没有办法，一个是没有证据，再一个是真的怕了。不论是贾东旭还是贾张氏，就算是易中海都吓破胆了。

这一周中，何雨柱已经把厨艺的基础都教给王野了。王野的学习能力也让何雨柱佩服，剩下的就得自己摸索了。王野也不着急，王野的两套菜谱都太高级了，里面的菜都是需要名贵的食材，什么燕窝鱼翅熊掌海参等等，王野现在可没有那么多好东西。

王野今天终于不用早起了，今天一早秦婉就带着王笑笑出去了。到了九点多王野终于醒了，正在洗漱的时候，陈洛兮进院了，王野吃惊的看着陈洛兮，嘴里的牙刷都忘了：“洛兮，你怎么来了？”

陈洛兮听见这话，顿时就不高兴了：“王野，你是不是忘了？咱们上次约的这个周末一起去玩儿。”

王野看陈洛兮那样子，好像随时都要哭了。赶紧说：“不是不是，没忘，怎么能忘呢！我这不是刚睡醒，脑子还在床上呢吗！”

陈洛兮看着王野嘴里喷着泡沫，又着急解释的滑稽样，“噗呲”一声笑了。

陈洛兮：“王野，你真是个大懒虫！都几点了你才起。”

王野：“大姐，我这一个星期都在忙，天天起的比鸡早，睡得比狗晚。好容易熬到周末了，睡个懒觉不过分吧？”

陈洛兮可没听见他的解释，她只听见王野叫她“大姐”了，气呼呼的说：“王野，你叫谁大姐呢？你看看我哪儿像大姐了？”

王野顺嘴就说：“对对对！你不是大姐，你是小......小妹妹！”

王野差点儿就说出小姐了。

“臭王野！你占我便宜。”陈洛兮气的都跺脚了。

“我怎么占你便宜了？不让叫姐，不让叫妹妹，那总不能让我叫你姑奶奶吧？”

陈洛兮嘟着嘴，气鼓鼓的在那里，我，我，我的不知道说什么。

王野快速的漱完口，简单的洗了两把脸。看着还在生气的陈洛兮说：“小姑奶奶，别生气了，我请你喝汽水行不？”

陈洛兮“哼”了一声就出了院子。两人直接去了供销社，王野买了两瓶汽水。两人在供销社门口喝完还了瓶才离开。

“王野，咱们去天坛玩吧！”

王野从来到这个时代还没有正经出去玩过，就答应了。可是到了天坛，王野就后悔了。这破地方可没有后世那样金碧辉煌。

用王野的眼光看，虽然不至于说残垣断壁。但也好不到哪里去，现在国家还很穷，哪有多余的钱来修缮这些古迹呀。王野看着现在的天坛，有点说不出的悲哀。

王野用后世在导游那里听到的一点知识，给陈洛兮讲解着天坛的历史。王野边走边说：“这天坛现在别看不是很辉煌，但这里是冬至祭天、孟春祈谷的地方，为什么祭天呢？其实就是当时的皇帝在作报告，跟上天汇报一下国家的情况。”

“其实大多数都是在吹吹牛。畅想一下未来，许许愿望什么的。再往里走就是回音壁了，听说有回音，我也没试过......”

正在王野巴拉巴拉说个没完的时候，迎面来了四个小青年，看样子也就十七八岁。每个人的打扮都是穿着白色衬衫，搭配深色的直筒长裤，腰间系着一条黑色的皮带，有俩还戴着一顶帽子，他们也不嫌热。

其中一个一看就是头儿的，上前一步流里流气的说：“呦！这谁呀？这不是咱们大院的小公主吗？怎么平时挺高冷的呀！怎么也出来交朋友啦？看这小子也不怎么样吗！原来咱们的小公主好这口呀！”

王野看向陈洛兮，轻声问：“认识？能揍他不？”

陈洛兮怕王野吃亏，上前一步：“赵星，你想干什么？忘了上次你爹为什么揍你了？还是你想我告诉赵明大哥，让他揍你？”

另外一个上前搂着赵星的肩膀，说：“呦！星哥，这小辣椒谁呀？介绍介绍。”

赵星嬉笑着说：“这可是我们大院里有名的小公主，那脾气大着呢！小心他一会打你！”

“嚯，还打人呀，我这人就是皮子痒，要不找个没人的地方打我一顿。”

陈洛兮哪听过这么流氓的话呀，撸袖子就要上前。

王野哪能就这么看着呀，一把拉住陈洛兮，把她拉到自己身后。王野还没说话，赵星就开口了：“嚯嚯嚯，这是英雄救美呀！你这是想出头呀！！”

王野紧皱眉头向前一步。其实他并不想和这些大院子弟起冲突，自己就是个小老百姓，他可不信前世那些爽文里，一个个的打了大院子弟还能收人家当小弟。

Time always flies by when we are busy, and in a blink of an eye it is the weekend again.The only big thing that happened this week was that Jia Dongxu had his leg broken. This time it should be the revenge of those gangsters.

Wang Ye didn't go to see the fun either. It was better to stay away from such things, in case he got angry and got burned.Although the Jia family knew that this was a follow-up to what happened last time, there was nothing they could do about Wang Ye. One was because there was no evidence, and the other was because he was really scared.Whether it was Jia Dongxu or Jia Zhang, even Yi Zhonghai was frightened.

During this week, He Yuzhu had taught Wang Ye the basics of cooking.Wang Ye's learning ability also impressed He Yuzhu, and he had to figure out the rest by himself.Wang Ye is not in a hurry. Both of Wang Ye's recipes are too high-end. The dishes in them all require precious ingredients, such as bird's nest, shark's fin, bear's paw, sea cucumber, etc. Wang Ye doesn't have that many good things now.

Wang Ye finally didn't have to get up early today. Qin Wan took Wang Xiaoxiao out early this morning.Wang Ye finally woke up at around nine o'clock. While he was washing up, Chen Luoxi entered the hospital. Wang Ye looked at Chen Luoxi in surprise, forgetting the toothbrush in his mouth: "Luoxi, why are you here?"

When Chen Luoxi heard this, she immediately became unhappy: "Wang Ye, have you forgotten? We made an appointment last time to go play together this weekend."

Wang Ye looked like Chen Luoxi was about to cry at any time.He quickly said: "No, no, I haven't forgotten, how could I forget! Didn't I just wake up and my mind is still in bed!"

Chen Luoxi laughed out loud when she saw Wang Ye spraying foam in his mouth and looking so funny in a hurry to explain.

Chen Luoxi: "Wang Ye, you are such a slacker! What time did you get up?"

Wang Ye: "Sister, I've been busy this week. I get up earlier than a chicken and go to bed later than a dog every day. I finally made it to the weekend. Isn't it too much to sleep in?"

Chen Luoxi didn't hear his explanation. She only heard Wang Ye call her "eldest sister" and said angrily: "Wang Ye, who do you call eldest sister? Look at how I look like eldest sister?"

Wang Ye said smoothly: "Yes, yes! You are not the eldest sister, you are the little... little sister!"

Wang Ye almost said Miss.

"Stinky Wang Ye! You took advantage of me." Chen Luoxi was so angry that she stamped her feet.

"Why did I take advantage of you? You're not allowed to call me sister or sister, so you can't let me call you aunt, right?"

Chen Luoxi pouted and was so angry, I, I, I don't know what to say.

Wang Ye quickly rinsed his mouth and washed his face briefly.Looking at Chen Luoxi who was still angry, she said, "Sister-in-law, don't be angry. Can I buy you a soda?"

Chen Luoxi left the yard with a "hum".The two went directly to the supply and marketing cooperative, and Wang Ye bought two bottles of soda.The two drank and returned bottles at the entrance of the supply and marketing cooperative before leaving.

"Wang Ye, let's go to the Temple of Heaven to play!"

Wang Ye had never seriously gone out to play in this era, so he agreed.But when he arrived at the Temple of Heaven, Wang Ye regretted it.This poor place is not as splendid as it would be in later generations.

From Wang Ye's point of view, although it would not be said to be in ruins.But it's not much better. The country is still very poor now, so there is no extra money to repair these monuments.Wang Ye looked at the current Temple of Heaven with an unspeakable sadness.

Wang Ye explained the history of the Temple of Heaven to Chen Luoxi using a little bit of knowledge he heard from the tour guide in later generations.Wang Ye said as he walked: "This Temple of Heaven may not look very splendid now, but this is the place where people worship the heaven in the winter solstice and pray for grains in the spring. Why worship the heaven? In fact, the emperor at that time was making a report, reporting the country's situation to heaven."

"Actually, most of them are just bragging. Think about the future, make wishes and so on. Walking further inside is the echo wall. I heard that there is echo, but I haven't tried it..."

While Wang Ye Balabala was talking endlessly, four young men came face to face. They looked to be about seventeen or eighteen years old.Everyone was dressed in white shirts, dark straight trousers, and a black belt around their waists. Two of them also wore hats. They were not too hot.

One of them, who seemed to be the boss at first sight, stepped forward and said eloquently: "Hey! Who is this? Isn't this the little princess of our compound? Why is she so aloof at ordinary times! Why does she come out to make friends? Look, this kid is not that good! It turns out our little princess is so good!"

Wang Ye looked at Chen Luoxi and asked softly: "Do you know him? Can you beat him?"

Chen Luoxi was afraid that Wang Ye would suffer, so she took a step forward: "Zhao Xing, what do you want to do? Have you forgotten why your father beat you last time? Or do you want me to tell Brother Zhao Ming and let him beat you?"

Another one stepped forward and put his arm around Zhao Xing's shoulders and said, "Hey! Brother Xing, who is this little pepper? Let me introduce you."

Zhao Xing said with a smile: "This is a famous little princess in our compound. She has a bad temper! Be careful, she will beat you!"

"Oh, you're still beating someone. I'm just itchy. Why don't you find a place where no one is around and beat me up."

Chen Luoxi had never heard of such a gangster, so she rolled up her sleeves and stepped forward.

How could Wang Ye just watch like this? He grabbed Chen Luoxi and pulled her behind him.Before Wang Ye could say anything, Zhao Xing spoke up: "Hohohoho, this is a hero saving a beauty! You are trying to get ahead!!"

Wang Ye frowned and took a step forward.In fact, he didn't want to conflict with these big courtyard brothers. He was just a common man. He didn't believe in the cool articles in his previous life where he beat the big courtyard brothers one by one and still accepted them as his junior brothers.
